name: chr_batman_gaslight_behavior.hkb
notes: Gaslight Batman's Havok behavior graph, pack 0xA0000122. Super Strength sub-machine SuperStrength_Car: Pickup_Start (bend and hold, waits for CarPickup) -> Pickup -> Hold (car idle / walk / run clips blended by the walk speed, variable 0x300) -> Throw (car leaves the hands at 0.20 s). Also KnockUp (FaceDown / FlipBack / FlipForward), Get Up (FaceDown / FaceUp), KnockDown, KnockBack, Stasis, Inactive, emotes, fidgets.
